const patch = "*** Begin Patch

+"""Vision-guided single-episode controller for the Meta-World hammer task.
+
+The controller uses only RGB-D observations, camera calibration, the task target,
+and the robot proprioception exposed by the standard service.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+DT = 0.0125
+
+
+class HammerController:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.robot = Robot()
+        self.spec = self.robot.spec()
+        self.cam = "topview"
+        self.obs = None
+        self.action_log = []
+
+    def observe(self):
+        self.obs = self.robot.get_obs(cameras=["topview", "front", "right"],
+                                      include_depth=True, video="mp4")
+        self.obs.save(str(OUT / "latest"))
+        return self.obs
+
+    def state(self):
+        return dict(zip(self.obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"],
+                        self.obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+
+    def world_from_pixel(self, camera, u, v, depth):
+        """Unproject one RGB-D pixel using the supplied OpenGL camera pose."""
+        c = self.obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+        K = np.asarray(c["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+        T = np.asarray(c["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+        z = float(depth)
+        xyz_cam_gl = np.array([(float(u)-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0],
+                               -(float(v)-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], z, 1.0])
+        return (T @ xyz_cam_gl)[:3]
+
+    def estimate_handle(self):
+        """Find the red hammer shaft, excluding the robot hand at the image bottom."""
+        im = np.asarray(self.obs.last["topview"], dtype=np.int16)
+        dep = np.asarray(self.obs.depth["topview"])[0].astype(float)
+        r, g, b = im[:, :, 0], im[:, :, 1], im[:, :, 2]
+        yy, xx = np.indices(r.shape)
+        mask = ((r > 105) & (r > 1.55*g) & (r > 1.35*b) &
+                (dep > 1.25) & (dep < 1.65) &
+                (xx >= 95) & (xx <= 165) & (yy >= 105) & (yy <= 130))
+        ys, xs = np.where(mask)
+        if len(xs) < 30:
+            raise RuntimeError("could not see the hammer shaft in the overhead RGB-D image")
+        # Trim endpoint/occlusion pixels; the middle of the shaft is a stable grasp point.
+        keep = (xs >= np.quantile(xs, .16)) & (xs <= np.quantile(xs, .84))
+        xs, ys = xs[keep], ys[keep]
+        u, v = float(np.median(xs)), float(np.median(ys))
+        d = float(np.median(dep[ys.astype(int), xs.astype(int)]))
+        p = self.world_from_pixel("topview", u, v, d)
+        return p, (u, v), int(len(xs))
+
+    def _send(self, actions, note):
+        a = np.asarray(actions, dtype=float)
+        if a.ndim == 1:
+            a = a[None, :]
+        res = self.robot.submit("ee_delta", a, dt=DT, interpolate="hold",
+                                cameras=["topview", "front"], video="mp4", note=note)
+        self.action_log.append({"note": note, "rows": len(a), "meta": res.meta})
+        self.obs = res
+        res.save(str(OUT / "latest"))
+        return res
+
+    def move_tcp(self, goal, grip=-1.0, max_step=0.003, settle_s=0.5, note="move"):
+        """Move by small world-frame increments, using proprioception for the start."""
+        s = self.state()
+        here = np.array([s["tcp_x"], s["tcp_y"], s["tcp_z"]], dtype=float)
+        delta = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float) - here
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(float(np.max(np.abs(delta))) / max_step)))
+        row = np.r_[delta / (n * 0.01), float(grip)]
+        self._send(np.tile(row, (n, 1)), note)
+        if settle_s > 0:
+            steps = max(1, int(round(settle_s / DT)))
+            self._send(np.tile([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, float(grip)], (steps, 1)), note + " settle")
+        self.observe()
+        s2 = self.state()
+        actual = np.array([s2["tcp_x"], s2["tcp_y"], s2["tcp_z"]])
+        print(json.dumps({"note": note, "target_tcp": list(map(float, goal)),
+                          "actual_tcp": actual.tolist(), "error": (np.asarray(goal)-actual).tolist(),
+                          "steps": self.obs.meta.get("control_steps")}, flush=True))
+        return actual
+
+    def hold_grip(self, grip, seconds=0.6, note="grip"):
+        n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
+        self._send(np.tile([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, float(grip)], (n, 1)), note)
+        return self.observe()
+
+    def save_log(self):
+        (OUT / "controller_log.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.action_log, indent=2))
+
+
+def main():
+    c = HammerController()
+    o = c.observe()
+    print("initial", json.dumps({"meta": {k: o.meta.get(k) for k in
+          ["time_left_s", "control_steps", "task"]}, "state": c.state()}, flush=True))
+    handle, uv, n = c.estimate_handle()
+    print("handle", json.dumps({"pixel": uv, "world": handle.tolist(), "pixels": n}, flush=True))
+
+    # Approach over the shaft while keeping the fingers open, then descend to it.
+    grasp_xy = handle[:2]
+    c.move_tcp([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], 0.12], grip=-1, note="approach above hammer")
+    c.move_tcp([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], 0.045], grip=-1, note="lower onto hammer handle")
+    c.save_log()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
